records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Next step after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then your workspace has been quiet, so I wanted to check in.

As a reminder, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring colleagues in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you set up that first project together 

Best,
Priya
